All existing `where` tests pass.

**Fix summary:** The bug was on line 1832 of `xarray/core/computation.py`. When `keep_attrs=True`, the lambda `lambda attrs, context: attrs[1]` assumed `x` (the second positional arg to `where`) would always contribute an entry to the `attrs` list. But `apply_ufunc` only collects `.attrs` from xarray objects — when `x` is a scalar like `1`, the list is shorter and `attrs[1]` raises `IndexError`. 

The fix adds a bounds check: `attrs[1] if len(attrs) > 1 else attrs[0]`, falling back to the first available attrs (from `cond`) when `x` is a scalar.
